title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 3: Akemi Ooshima
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ Ｖｏｌ．３ ～大島朱美～
overview:
Akemi Ooshima

An idol for you, and only for you - yes, a Private Idol!

Volume 3 of the Private Idol Disc series is a digital photo book starring Akemi Ooshima. In the Photo Hall you choose the pictures you want to see from outdoor, studio and private shoots. The Video Hall plays short movies, including her self-introductions and image footage.

- Photo Hall: outdoor, studio and private photo sets
- Video Hall: short video clips
- Bonus: a "look this way" mini game
- Production credits

大島朱美

あなたのための、あなただけのアイドル
そうプライベートアイドル!
